notes: Requirements come from the department's current-students page (lower-division prep: CMPSC 16, 24, 32, 40, 64) and the 2024-25 GEAR (upper division: CMPSC 130A-B, ENGR 101, 14 electives). engineering.ucsb.edu returned 504 on every request, so GEAR was read from an Internet Archive snapshot (March 2025). Course sites are mostly instructor pages on sites.cs.ucsb.edu; the recent ones are not public.
